changelog: - **Escape closes only the screen on top.** With the run row folded and its Run settings popover open, opening Run ▸ Monte Carlo… from the keyboard and pressing Escape closed the popover behind the dialog and left the dialog open until a second Escape. Now a dialog or sheet above the Run settings popover or the Share result panel takes the Escape alone; the next Escape closes the popover or the panel as before, returning the focus to its button.
